brief:
Analysts say Donald Trump's Board of Peace has failed in its attempts to secure a lasting ceasefire in Gaza over the past year, Al Jazeera English reported. The board, established to broker peace following initial ceasefire talks, has not achieved its stated objectives of stabilizing the territory or advancing toward a durable settlement.

The assessment reflects widespread skepticism about the effectiveness of the initiative in addressing the underlying conflict and humanitarian crisis in Gaza. No further details on specific failures or the board's activities were immediately available.
dek: Analysts say board has 'failed' in its attempts to secure lasting peace in Gaza.
title: Trump's Gaza peace board fails to secure lasting ceasefire, analysts say
